name: Mailshake
description_en:
Mailshake combines personalized email sequences, lead management, deliverability tools and optional multichannel calling. Its Data Finder supplies prospect contact data; Lead Catcher helps organize engagement. It is oriented toward sales outreach rather than replacing a CRM or a full newsletter lifecycle platform. Published customer revenue and response-rate claims were not independently reproduced.

A practical pilot is to connect a supported Gmail, Microsoft or SMTP/IMAP mailbox, import a small reviewed list, map personalization fields, and schedule the first email plus follow-ups. Use A/B variants only after confirming each recipient’s fields resolve correctly. Route engaged replies to an owner and check the campaign before reenrolling someone. Exact automated recovery and duplicate suppression were not established by the pages reviewed.
description_zh:
Mailshake 组合个性化邮件序列、线索管理、送达工具与可选多渠道电话。Data Finder 提供潜在客户联系数据，Lead Catcher 帮助组织互动。它面向销售触达，不等于 CRM 或完整新闻邮件生命周期平台。客户收入与回复率宣传未经独立复现。

可连接受支持的 Gmail、Microsoft 或 SMTP/IMAP 邮箱，导入少量已审查名单，映射个性化字段，并安排首封邮件及跟进。先确认每位收件人的字段正确，再使用 A/B 变体。应把感兴趣的回复交给负责人，重新入序前检查活动。本次页面未确认精确自动恢复与去重语义。

core_features.explanation_en: Build follow-up campaigns with mapped contact fields.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过映射联系字段建立跟进活动。

core_features.explanation_en: The higher tier adds phone outreach and regional minute allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: 较高套餐增加电话触达与地区分钟额度。

Use A/B variants only after confirming each recipient’s fields resolve correctly. Route engaged replies to an owner and check the campaign before reenrolling someone. Exact automated recovery and duplicate suppression were not established by the pages reviewed.
steps.zh: 可连接受支持的 Gmail、Microsoft 或 SMTP/IMAP 邮箱，导入少量已审查名单，映射个性化字段，并安排首封邮件及跟进。先确认每位收件人的字段正确，再使用 A/B 变体。应把感兴趣的回复交给负责人，重新入序前检查活动。本次页面未确认精确自动恢复与去重语义。

items.en: Shortlist Mailshake when the team wants a relatively focused outreach workflow and can own list quality, provider setup and replies. Calling outside the included region and extra data can change the total. “Unlimited” sends or warmup does not guarantee inbox placement, and the provider’s limits still need evaluation. The service is accessed online; self-hosting and source-code licensing were not established. Check bounce status and already-sent messages before retrying a failed campaign.
items.zh: 当团队需要相对聚焦的触达流程，并能负责名单质量、供应商设置与回复时，可考虑 Mailshake。包含地区之外的通话与额外数据会改变总成本。“无限”发送或预热不保证进入收件箱，供应商限制仍需评估。服务在线访问，未确认自托管与源代码许可。重试失败活动前应先检查退信状态和已发送消息。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing cards display Starter $29 monthly/$25 yearly equivalent, Email Outreach $49/$45, and Sales Engagement $99/$85. Starter lists 1,500 monthly sends; Sales Engagement adds a dialer and unlimited North American calling minutes. The FAQ says payment is collected upfront and no free trial is offered. Card mailbox allowances of one, two and ten differ from a FAQ stating one mailbox per purchased user; obtain a written seat/mailbox quote instead of silently choosing either interpretation. Data Finder and ready-made mailboxes are additional offers.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价卡展示 Starter 月付 29 美元／年付折算 25，Email Outreach 49／45，Sales Engagement 99／85。Starter 列每月 1,500 封；Sales Engagement 增加拨号器与北美无限通话分钟。FAQ 说明先付款、没有免费试用。卡片的一、二、十个邮箱额度，与 FAQ“每购买用户一个邮箱”的说明不同；应取得席位／邮箱书面报价，不能自行选择一种解释。Data Finder 与预配置邮箱属于其他收费项目。
